list.comment:
feat: replace `react-cookie` with `js-cookie` and improve token handling
- Swap `react-cookie` with `js-cookie` for cookie management. - Add optional `genres_names` property to `TrendingMovie` model. - Enhance `addToWatchList` to include genre names in watchlist items. - Refine authentication checks in routing and login flow. - Update watchlist UI with improved handling of single and plural item labels.

feat: add YouTube URL utilities, time formatter, new route, and background color update
- Add `getYouTubeEmbedUrl` and `getYouTubeUrl` utility functions. - Create a time formatting utility for minutes to hours and minutes. - Introduce a new `/movies/$movieId` route in the route tree. - Update background color variable in CSS for a more consistent theme. - Include `ApiQueryLanguage` constant for TMDB API language configuration.

feat: add CardImageSkeleton, movie details route, and improve skeleton loading states
- Introduce `CardImageSkeleton` for placeholder rendering in card components. - Implement `/movies/$movieId` route to display detailed movie information. - Optimize loading states with `MovieCarrouselSkeleton` in carousels. - Refactor `PosterSize` model from type to enum for stronger typing. - Update `getPosterUrl` to handle undefined paths gracefully.

feat: add person details route and TMDB person service
- Implement `/people/$personId` route for displaying detailed information about a person. - Add `getPersonDetails` function in TMDB person service using React Query. - Create `Person` model to define the structure of person data. - Update `CardImage` to support redirection to the person details route.

feat: append credits to person details and display popular movies
- Update TMDB person service to include `credits` in the response. - Extend the `Person` model to include `credits` with cast details. - Add a `MovieCarrousel` component to the person details route for displaying popular movies.

feat: update poster sizes for better image quality in movie components
- Change `PosterSize` in `UpcomingMainCard` to `Original` for higher resolution images. - Update `PosterSize` in `MovieCarrousel` to `Large` and add redirection to the movies section.

feat: integrate watchlist management across movie components
- Add `useWatchListStore` with Zustand for managing watchlist state. - Enable add/remove watchlist actions in `UpcomingMainCard`, `TrendingCarrousel`, `MovieCarrousel`, and `PopularCarrousel`. - Update `CardImage` with dynamic watchlist buttons (add/remove). - Create `watchList` route to display saved movies using `MovieCarrousel`. - Add `zustand` dependency to project.

feat: implement cookie-based token management for authentication
- Add `cookie.store.ts` for handling token get, set, and remove operations. - Migrate auth context logic to use cookies for authentication state validation. - Replace hardcoded checks with cookie validation in route guards. - Install `react-cookie` dependency for cookie management in React. - Update login flow to set a token on successful authentication.

feat: implement cookie-based token management for authentication
- Add `cookie.store.ts` for handling token get, set, and remove operations. - Migrate auth context logic to use cookies for authentication state validation. - Replace hardcoded checks with cookie validation in route guards. - Install `react-cookie` dependency for cookie management in React. - Update login flow to set a token on successful authentication.

feat: integrate watchlist functionality with authentication and routing
- Extend `useWatchListStore` to support movies and TV shows. - Add dynamic watchlist actions to movie details and watchlist routes. - Update routing and authentication context to improve token handling. - Simplify `CardImage` and `MovieCarrousel` with watchlist integration. - Refactor `beforeLoad` logic to centralize authentication checks.
